name: Dorso v1.10.0
body:
## What's New

### Automatic Tracking Mode
- **Switch between Camera and AirPods automatically** — Dorso now intelligently switches between your camera and AirPods based on availability. Set your preferred source and Dorso falls back to the other when needed, then returns when your preferred device reconnects.
- **New Settings UI** — The tracking section now shows device status, calibration state, and active source at a glance.

### Architecture Overhaul
- Migrated core tracking logic to The Composable Architecture (TCA) for more predictable state management and improved testability. Comprehensive test coverage added for all tracking scenarios.

### Improved Translations
- French and Spanish translations refined for more natural phrasing throughout the app.

### Acknowledgments
- Thanks to [@bradystroud](https://github.com/bradystroud) for suggesting automatic source switching in [#66](https://github.com/tldev/dorso/issues/66)!
- Thanks to [@emmanuelprecieuxargent](https://github.com/emmanuelprecieuxargent) for improving the French ([#71](https://github.com/tldev/dorso/pull/71)) and Spanish ([#73](https://github.com/tldev/dorso/pull/73)) translations!

## Installation

4. Grant camera permission and complete calibration
